otpDescription: Save settings first, then click 'Start Login' to receive a one-time password via email. Enter the code and click 'Submit OTP'.
vccApiKeyHelp: Get your API key at developer.volvocars.com
wallboxIds: EVSE ID(s) of your Volvo wallbox
wallboxIdsHelp: The EVSE ID is on the document Volvo provided with the wallbox. Several IDs separated by commas. Leave empty if you have no Volvo wallbox. After adding a wallbox, log in again once so the adapter gets the wallbox permissions.
